meta.title: The Future Mail Sent To The Past
meta.description: The strength of humanity often overcomes set formulae.

units.rawText: December 21st, 12:00 Magrasea Time.
units.displayText: December 21st, 12:00 Magrasea Time.

spans.text: December 21st, 12:00 Magrasea Time.

units.rawText: In the Oasis Ops Room.
units.displayText: In the Oasis Ops Room.

spans.text: In the Oasis Ops Room.

units.rawText: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.
units.displayText: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.

spans.text: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.

units.rawText: Uuuurgh...
units.displayText: Uuuurgh...

spans.text: Uuuurgh...

units.rawText: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth is shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.
units.displayText: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth is shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.

spans.text: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth is shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.

units.rawText: ...Did I fall asleep?
units.displayText: ...Did I fall asleep?

spans.text: ...Did I fall asleep?

units.rawText: The Ops Room is empty, and nobody answers my question. I look around and see the rays of the blazing sun streaming in from outside the window. It is only then that I finally regain a sense of groundedness amidst the strange wave of unreality that seems to have overcome me.
units.displayText: The Ops Room is empty, and nobody answers my question. I look around and see the rays of the blazing sun streaming in from outside the window. It is only then that I finally regain a sense of groundedness amidst the strange wave of unreality that seems to have overcome me.

spans.text: The Ops Room is empty, and nobody answers my question. I look around and see the rays of the blazing sun streaming in from outside the window. It is only then that I finally regain a sense of groundedness amidst the strange wave of unreality that seems to have overcome me.

units.rawText: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.
units.displayText: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.

spans.text: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.

units.rawText: It's a message...
units.displayText: It's a message...

spans.text: It's a message...

units.rawText: I open my communicator, and the contents within are just as unreal as what I felt before.
units.displayText: I open my communicator, and the contents within are just as unreal as what I felt before.

spans.text: I open my communicator, and the contents within are just as unreal as what I felt before.

units.rawText: Knock knock.
units.displayText: Knock knock.

spans.text: Knock knock.

units.rawText: Pardon me, Professor. I came to clarify some documents with you...
units.displayText: Pardon me, Professor. I came to clarify some documents with you...

spans.text: Pardon me, Professor. I came to clarify some documents with you...

units.rawText: ...But you don't look too well. Would you like some coffee to refresh you?
units.displayText: ...But you don't look too well. Would you like some coffee to refresh you?

spans.text: ...But you don't look too well. Would you like some coffee to refresh you?

units.rawText: Thank you, Persicaria. I'll take it a little sweeter, though not as sweet as your usual.
units.displayText: Thank you, Persicaria. I'll take it a little sweeter, though not as sweet as your usual.

spans.text: Thank you, Persicaria. I'll take it a little sweeter, though not as sweet as your usual.

units.rawText: Professor, why don't you leave the rest of today's work to me? You should head back early and get some rest.
units.displayText: Professor, why don't you leave the rest of today's work to me? You should head back early and get some rest.

spans.text: Professor, why don't you leave the rest of today's work to me? You should head back early and get some rest.

units.rawText: Hehe, do I look that tired? ...And thanks for the coffee.
units.displayText: Hehe, do I look that tired? ...And thanks for the coffee.

spans.text: Hehe, do I look that tired? ...And thanks for the coffee.

units.rawText: I take a sip of it. The overly-sweet taste does much to clear my head up. I look at the communicator's screen again.
units.displayText: I take a sip of it. The overly-sweet taste does much to clear my head up. I look at the communicator's screen again.

spans.text: I take a sip of it. The overly-sweet taste does much to clear my head up. I look at the communicator's screen again.

units.rawText: Is there a problem? Perhaps I might be able to help.
units.displayText: Is there a problem? Perhaps I might be able to help.

spans.text: Is there a problem? Perhaps I might be able to help.

units.rawText: It's just a strange mail.
units.displayText: It's just a strange mail.

spans.text: It's just a strange mail.

units.rawText: Let me see... It reads, <color=orange>"13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg"</color> ...Doesn't make much sense, no.
units.displayText: Let me see... It reads, "13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg" ...Doesn't make much sense, no.

spans.text: Let me see... It reads,
"13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg"
...Doesn't make much sense, no.

units.rawText: Now that you mention it, it's around 12 noon now. If 13:30 is the time then... that would be one and a half hours later.
units.displayText: Now that you mention it, it's around 12 noon now. If 13:30 is the time then... that would be one and a half hours later.

spans.text: Now that you mention it, it's around 12 noon now. If 13:30 is the time then... that would be one and a half hours later.

units.rawText: Yeah, and also, the sender information is pretty weird, too.
units.displayText: Yeah, and also, the sender information is pretty weird, too.

spans.text: Yeah, and also, the sender information is pretty weird, too.

units.rawText: The sent date is... several days later... and it's from yourself?
units.displayText: The sent date is... several days later... and it's from yourself?

spans.text: The sent date is... several days later... and it's from yourself?

units.rawText: Yeah, I guess it must be an agent pulling a prank. Just in case, I think I should send one of our patrol teams outside the Oasis to those coordinates to see if anything's going on.
units.displayText: Yeah, I guess it must be an agent pulling a prank. Just in case, I think I should send one of our patrol teams outside the Oasis to those coordinates to see if anything's going on.

spans.text: Yeah, I guess it must be an agent pulling a prank. Just in case, I think I should send one of our patrol teams outside the Oasis to those coordinates to see if anything's going on.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll have Antonina work on finding the source of this email.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll have Antonina work on finding the source of this email.

spans.text: Alright, I'll have Antonina work on finding the source of this email.

units.rawText: I nod and hand the communicator to Persicaria before burying my head in my work again. Despite that, a strange feeling of restlessness is still coiling around my heart, as though there's an answer just waiting to be revealed that I've overlooked.
units.displayText: I nod and hand the communicator to Persicaria before burying my head in my work again. Despite that, a strange feeling of restlessness is still coiling around my heart, as though there's an answer just waiting to be revealed that I've overlooked.

spans.text: I nod and hand the communicator to Persicaria before burying my head in my work again. Despite that, a strange feeling of restlessness is still coiling around my heart, as though there's an answer just waiting to be revealed that I've overlooked.

units.rawText: I've told Antonina about it already, but she's probably still absorbed in her antique computer equipment.
units.displayText: I've told Antonina about it already, but she's probably still absorbed in her antique computer equipment.

spans.text: I've told Antonina about it already, but she's probably still absorbed in her antique computer equipment.

units.rawText: Persicaria hands the communicator back to me as she says so.
units.displayText: Persicaria hands the communicator back to me as she says so.

spans.text: Persicaria hands the communicator back to me as she says so.

units.rawText: ...Actually, that message does sound like something you'd send, Professor.
units.displayText: ...Actually, that message does sound like something you'd send, Professor.

spans.text: ...Actually, that message does sound like something you'd send, Professor.

units.rawText: Why do you say that?
units.displayText: Why do you say that?

spans.text: Why do you say that?

units.rawText: Look here.
units.displayText: Look here.

spans.text: Look here.

units.rawText: She points to the contents of the message.
units.displayText: She points to the contents of the message.

spans.text: She points to the contents of the message.

units.rawText: <color=orange>"13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg"</color> ....I just realized the "O" of "Oasis" was a "0" instead.
units.displayText: "13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg" ....I just realized the "O" of "Oasis" was a "0" instead.

spans.text: "13:30(35.6,139.7)distracSNC0asisEdg"
....I just realized the "O" of "Oasis" was a "0" instead.

units.rawText: Both Dolls and native agents follow their programming when they do work, so they would generate messages the same way.
units.displayText: Both Dolls and native agents follow their programming when they do work, so they would generate messages the same way.

spans.text: Both Dolls and native agents follow their programming when they do work, so they would generate messages the same way.

units.rawText: Errors in manual entry like this are things that humans would make. It also seems like the kind of mistake you'd make, too.
units.displayText: Errors in manual entry like this are things that humans would make. It also seems like the kind of mistake you'd make, too.

spans.text: Errors in manual entry like this are things that humans would make. It also seems like the kind of mistake you'd make, too.

units.rawText: Persicaria chuckles quietly. The familiar scent of coffee fills the air, and I feel my scrambled thoughts slowly clearing up.
units.displayText: Persicaria chuckles quietly. The familiar scent of coffee fills the air, and I feel my scrambled thoughts slowly clearing up.

spans.text: Persicaria chuckles quietly. The familiar scent of coffee fills the air, and I feel my scrambled thoughts slowly clearing up.

units.rawText: Also, there's one thing that bothered me... These coordinates are about as precise as you can get for describing a location, so why did the sender have to add "0asisEdg" at the end?
units.displayText: Also, there's one thing that bothered me... These coordinates are about as precise as you can get for describing a location, so why did the sender have to add "0asisEdg" at the end?

spans.text: Also, there's one thing that bothered me... These coordinates are about as precise as you can get for describing a location, so why did the sender have to add "0asisEdg" at the end?

units.rawText: It's probably redundant info. Or maybe it's a hint, for emphasis? Or...
units.displayText: It's probably redundant info. Or maybe it's a hint, for emphasis? Or...

spans.text: It's probably redundant info. Or maybe it's a hint, for emphasis? Or...

units.rawText: "0asis"... emphasis...
units.displayText: "0asis"... emphasis...

spans.text: "0asis"... emphasis...

units.rawText: I suddenly recall something and rummage through the documents I just approved.
units.displayText: I suddenly recall something and rummage through the documents I just approved.

spans.text: I suddenly recall something and rummage through the documents I just approved.

units.rawText: The knot in my heart finally unravels, as though I've found the answer, and the sense of uneasiness and emptiness slowly fades.
units.displayText: The knot in my heart finally unravels, as though I've found the answer, and the sense of uneasiness and emptiness slowly fades.

spans.text: The knot in my heart finally unravels, as though I've found the answer, and the sense of uneasiness and emptiness slowly fades.

units.rawText: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.

spans.text: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Professor? Ah, could it be...
units.displayText: Professor? Ah, could it be...

spans.text: Professor? Ah, could it be...

units.rawText: Emphasizing things like this is definitely my style.
units.displayText: Emphasizing things like this is definitely my style.

spans.text: Emphasizing things like this is definitely my style.

units.rawText: That said, it's still a bit annoying to have my actions so thoroughly read, even if it's by myself...
units.displayText: That said, it's still a bit annoying to have my actions so thoroughly read, even if it's by myself...

spans.text: That said, it's still a bit annoying to have my actions so thoroughly read, even if it's by myself...

units.rawText: I put the document down. The note on it that's supposed to say "Oasis" reads "0asis" instead, proving that the mail came from its writer's hand.
units.displayText: I put the document down. The note on it that's supposed to say "Oasis" reads "0asis" instead, proving that the mail came from its writer's hand.

spans.text: I put the document down. The note on it that's supposed to say "Oasis" reads "0asis" instead, proving that the mail came from its writer's hand.

units.rawText: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.
units.displayText: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.

spans.text: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.
